ContactMessage.title: ContactMessage
ContactMessage.description: A contact form submission sent by a website visitor and readable only by the site owner.

subject.description: Selected or custom subject of the inquiry.

lang.description: Website language used when submitting the form.

status.description: Inbox triage state of the message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message status was last updated.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Server-provisioned admin record granting inbox access.

/contact_messages/{messageId}.description: Stores incoming website contact form messages. Public write-only create with strict schema validation; admin-only read, status update, and delete.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Locked collection for optional additional admin UIDs; client writes are completely forbidden.
